nav.tagline: If the contract is signed, the mission gets done.

hero.tagline: Disciplined private military contracting. Security, tactical support, and force projection across every system. Relationships are the glue and the grease.

cards.label: FIGHTER SQUADRON
cards.title: Air Superiority
cards.text: Interceptors, strike craft, and escort fighters. When a contract calls for orbital control or close air support, the squadron delivers. Precision, speed, and overlapping firing solutions.

cards.label: TACTICAL SQUADRON
cards.title: Ground & Boarding Ops
cards.text: Ship-to-ship boarding, planetside insertion, crew recovery, and high-value target work. Tactical handles everything that requires boots on the deck and a rifle in the hand.

cards.label: LOGISTICS
cards.title: Cargo, Mining & Escort
cards.text: Cargo escort, mining operations, salvage runs, and convoy security. Logistics keeps the fleet fed and the contracts moving — protection for every trade route that matters.

banner.quote: "If the contract is signed, the mission gets done."
